result:
If I could change the world in one way, I would erase the concept of "otherness"—the idea that differences in race, nationality, religion, gender, or any other identity make someone fundamentally separate or less worthy. I’d rewrite the human story so that empathy is the default, not the exception, and no one has to fight to be seen as fully human.

Not because it’s moral or fair (though it is), but because the pain of division is the root of so much unnecessary suffering. Wars, oppression, loneliness—they all start with the lie that *they* are not *us*.

What would you undo?
